limits: Static AST/text analysis at read time, not execution: a runner's runtime behaviour, aliasing beyond the resolved constant map, or a write performed by a helper it calls can differ from this census, which is why could-not-evaluate rows are never greened.

Recognized write idioms are write_text/write_bytes, open() in a write mode, os.replace/os.rename/shutil.move, Path.replace with a resolvable receiver, and receipt writes embedded in string literals; other publication idioms are recorded only when their destination resolves.
Row digests pin the bytes read during this census, not HEAD at commit time; re-run after any landing that touches a runner.
This tool executes no round runner and writes no filed receipt; --out refuses absolute paths, path escapes, and validation.json destinations.
